proj-1: A pencil drawing of a big bowl heaped with trail mix (cereal rings, little pretzels and raisins) with a big spoon in it, a one-cup measuring cup filled level, and a small fluted paper cup of mix.
proj-2: A pencil drawing of a square felt card leaning back with a big two-hole button sewn on its middle, the yarn running down to a large plastic needle on the table, and a ball of yarn behind.
proj-3: A pencil drawing of a round plate with three fruit kabobs on paper straws, each threaded in the same pattern of melon cubes, grape halves, banana rounds and strawberries, with a spare strawberry and a grape on the table.
proj-4: A pencil drawing of a tall clear glass showing six even layers of yogurt, granola and berries, with berries on top and a long spoon in it, beside a half-cup measure of granola and a few loose blueberries.
proj-5: A pencil drawing of a felt bookmark with a pointed end and a tassel, lying on the table with an even pale running stitch all round its edge, the floss running on to a blunt needle, with a ruler behind and a stick of chalk in front.
proj-6: A pencil drawing of a small tray lined with wax paper holding three neat rows of round oat energy bites, all the same size and dotted with chips, with the mixing bowl and spoon behind.
proj-7: A pencil drawing of a finished felt pouch lying on the table, its flap folded over and held shut by an elastic loop round a button, with a spool of floss behind and two pins in front.
proj-8: A pencil drawing of a big bowl of torn lettuce topped with cherry tomatoes and cucumber rounds, beside a small jar of cloudy vinaigrette with its lid off and a measuring spoon.
proj-9: A pencil drawing of a whole homemade pizza on its pan, with a puffed hand-stretched crust and bubbling cheese topped with pepperoni and pepper rings, cut into eight slices, beside a pizza-cutter wheel.
proj-10: A pencil drawing of a finished cotton drawstring bag standing on the table, pulled shut so the top gathers into soft folds, its cord ends hanging down the front with knots, beside a thimble and a threaded needle.
proj-11: A pencil drawing of a pan of fluffy scrambled-egg curds with a dial food thermometer standing in them, a spatula resting across the rim, and two whole eggs in front, one standing on end and one lying on its side.
proj-12: A pencil drawing of a plump square pillow in a striped cover standing on the table, turned to show its envelope back where the two hemmed pieces overlap, with a spool of thread and a pincushion stuck with pins beside it.
proj-13: A pencil drawing of a wok of stir-fried vegetables (broccoli florets, carrot rounds and pepper strips, all cut even) with a wooden spatula resting in it, beside a small bowl of rice.
proj-14: A pencil drawing of a finished canvas tote bag standing on the table with its two straps arched up, in front of a sewing machine with a spool of thread on top.
proj-15: A pencil drawing of a big pot of vegetable soup with a ladle in it, a filled soup bowl in front showing even little cubes of vegetables and pasta, and a cutting board of diced carrot.
proj-16: A pencil drawing of a covered cooking pot, a stack of four dinner plates, a cost sheet on a clipboard with a column of lines, and a pocket calculator.
proj-17: A pencil drawing of a neatly folded shirt with its collar and a row of buttons, a square patch stitched on with bold visible stitches, a spool of thread with a needle in it, and a spare button.
proj-18: A pencil drawing of a long hoagie roll cut in half on a slant, the two halves pulled apart on a wooden board so the layers of cheese, meat and lettuce show, each half held with a toothpick, and a tomato slice beside the board.
proj-19: A pencil drawing of three twisted soft pretzels, deep brown and sprinkled with coarse salt, on a parchment-lined baking sheet, beside a small bowl of melted butter with a pastry brush.
proj-20: A pencil drawing of a baking dish of lasagna with a bubbled cheese top and one square lifted out, that slice on a plate in front showing its neat layers, and a spatula beside it.
proj-21: A pencil drawing of a tall domed loaf of homemade bread on a wooden board, with two cut slices leaning away from it, and a small honey jar with a wooden dipper behind.
